eyebrow.zh: 从已保存的 SSE 轨迹或本地代理流重组 tool-call 参数，按模型规则修复 JSON，并输出修复轨迹。
eyebrow.en: Reassemble tool-call arguments from saved SSE traces or live proxy streams, repair JSON with model-specific rules, and inspect the repair trace.

headline.zh:
工具参数坏了，
先修复再检查
headline.en:
Broken tool arguments.
Repair, then inspect.

sub.zh: 从已保存的 SSE 轨迹或本地代理流重组 tool-call 参数，按模型规则修复 JSON，并输出修复轨迹。
sub.en: Reassemble tool-call arguments from saved SSE traces or live proxy streams, repair JSON with model-specific rules, and inspect the repair trace.

caption.zh: SSE 重组 · JSON 修复

body.zh: 按调用索引组合 SSE 参数片段。
body.en: Combine SSE argument fragments by call index.

body.zh: RepairSpec 将模型形状与修复策略放在一起。
body.en: RepairSpec keeps model shapes and repair strategies together.

title.zh: 字符串内的换行也修复

body.zh: v0.3.0：字符串值里的原始换行与制表符会转义成合法 JSON，空参数的工具调用不再被误报为修复失败，修复失败时原样回放上游流。
body.en: v0.3.0: raw newlines and tabs inside string values are escaped to valid JSON, zero-argument tool calls no longer fail repair, and unrepairable streams are replayed verbatim.

body.zh: stdout 输出 JSON，stderr 保留诊断信息。
body.en: stdout carries JSON while stderr retains diagnostics.

title.zh: 把格式问题留在可检查的边界
title.en: Keep format repair at an inspectable boundary

body.zh: 流式工具参数可能夹着围栏、sentinel，或缺失闭合字符。CallPatch 读取完整保存的 SSE，先按 tool-call 索引拼接，再运行有限的确定性修复。它让参数可以被检查，不代替调用者判断修复后的含义是否正确。
body.en: Streamed tool arguments may contain fences or sentinels, or lack closing characters. CallPatch reads a saved SSE stream, reassembles calls by index, and applies bounded deterministic repairs. The result is inspectable JSON; callers still judge whether the repaired meaning is correct.

body.zh: 实际修复仓库自带的 Qwen3 与 DeepSeek SSE 示例。输出证明这两条输入经过修复后能生成参数 JSON，不证明截断前的原始语义被完整恢复；实时代理由 serve 子命令提供。
body.en: The run repairs the supplied Qwen3 and DeepSeek SSE examples. It demonstrates argument JSON generation for these inputs, not exact recovery of original intent; the live proxy is the serve subcommand.

alt.zh: 实际修复仓库自带的 Qwen3 与 DeepSeek SSE 示例。输出证明这两条输入经过修复后能生成参数 JSON，不证明截断前的原始语义被完整恢复；实时代理由 serve 子命令提供。
alt.en: The run repairs the supplied Qwen3 and DeepSeek SSE examples. It demonstrates argument JSON generation for these inputs, not exact recovery of original intent; the live proxy is the serve subcommand.

body.zh: internal/proxy/sse.go 重组 delta；internal/spec 根据模型选择 RepairSpec；internal/repair 处理围栏、引号、sentinel 与括号。repair 子命令把修复后的工具 envelope 写到 stdout；serve 子命令在本地反向代理的流内做同样修复。
body.en: internal/proxy/sse.go reassembles deltas, internal/spec selects a RepairSpec, and internal/repair handles fences, quotes, sentinels and braces. The repair subcommand writes repaired envelopes to stdout; the serve subcommand applies the same repair inside a local reverse proxy.

alt.zh: internal/proxy/sse.go 重组 delta；internal/spec 根据模型选择 RepairSpec；internal/repair 处理围栏、引号、sentinel 与括号。repair 子命令把修复后的工具 envelope 写到 stdout；serve 子命令在本地反向代理的流内做同样修复。
alt.en: internal/proxy/sse.go reassembles deltas, internal/spec selects a RepairSpec, and internal/repair handles fences, quotes, sentinels and braces. The repair subcommand writes repaired envelopes to stdout; the serve subcommand applies the same repair inside a local reverse proxy.

body.zh: CallPatch 的输入是已记录的失败轨迹，输出是待检查的参数 envelope。它与 Agent 或推理服务分工不同，不负责执行工具、补全任务或保证任意后端兼容。
body.en: CallPatch consumes recorded failure traces and produces argument envelopes for inspection. It does not execute tools, complete an agent task or guarantee arbitrary backend compatibility.

alt.zh: CallPatch 的输入是已记录的失败轨迹，输出是待检查的参数 envelope。它与 Agent 或推理服务分工不同，不负责执行工具、补全任务或保证任意后端兼容。
alt.en: CallPatch consumes recorded failure traces and produces argument envelopes for inspection. It does not execute tools, complete an agent task or guarantee arbitrary backend compatibility.

body.zh: callpatch serve --upstream http://127.0.0.1:8081 在本地反向代理的流式响应里运行同一套修复；干净流原样转发，需要修复时重新合成干净的 OpenAI SSE。
body.en: callpatch serve --upstream http://127.0.0.1:8081 runs the same repair on a local reverse proxy's streamed responses; clean streams pass through verbatim and broken ones are re-emitted as clean OpenAI SSE.

note.zh: 实际修复仓库自带的 Qwen3 与 DeepSeek SSE 示例。输出证明这两条输入经过修复后能生成参数 JSON，不证明截断前的原始语义被完整恢复，也没有运行实时代理。
note.en: The run repairs the supplied Qwen3 and DeepSeek SSE examples. It demonstrates argument JSON generation for these inputs, not exact recovery of original intent or live proxy operation.

body.zh: 从保存的 Qwen3 输入恢复可解析参数。
body.en: Recover parseable arguments from the saved Qwen3 input.

body.zh: 显式选择 DeepSeek 规则处理第二条输入。
body.en: Apply the explicitly selected DeepSeek rules to the second input.

body.zh: 需要 Go 1.24+。示例用 go run 执行源码，首次构建可能下载依赖；修复本身只读取本地文件。
body.en: Requires Go 1.24+. The demo uses go run; initial building may fetch dependencies. The repair itself reads local files only.

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/callpatch.git
cd callpatch
go build -o callpatch ./cmd/callpatch

go run ./cmd/callpatch repair --trace testdata/qwen3-broken.sse
go run ./cmd/callpatch repair --trace --model deepseek-v4 testdata/deepseek-broken.sse

limitations.zh: 合成或补齐的参数需要人工或调用方校验，合法 JSON 不等于正确操作。
limitations.en: Reconstructed arguments need caller review; valid JSON does not imply a correct operation.

limitations.zh: serve 的修复路径在 httptest 集成测试下验证，尚未录制真实 llama.cpp 会话的端到端 demo；接入真实 Agent 前先用自己的轨迹验证。
limitations.en: The serve repair path is verified under httptest integration tests; an end-to-end demo against a real llama.cpp session has not been recorded. Validate with your own traces before pointing an agent at it.

limitations.zh: 未知模型会回退 Qwen3 规则，需留意 stderr。
limitations.en: Unknown models fall back to Qwen3 rules; inspect stderr.
